name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-05-19, at wavelengths from 1.06 to 3.73 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
